subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Forms lower case letters correctly, aligned to the phonics programme

show.line: Let's write our letters. s curls like a snake. a goes round, then down. Watch and trace!

rounds.prompt: Trace s with your finger. Start at the top, curl one way, then the other.
Trace a with your finger. Go round, then a line down.
Tap the letter that says t.
Trace t with your finger. A tall line down, then a cross.
Trace p with your finger. A long line down, back up, then round.
Which letter has a long tail that hangs down?
rounds.praise: p hangs its tail below the line.

hints: Start at the top. Small letters sit on the line.
Go slowly. Follow the arrow with your finger.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write t.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I forgot the cross. That is not t yet.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's fix it together. Tall line down, then a cross. Now it is t!

parent_line: Can trace the letters s, a, t and p the right way.
